name: website-rebuild-tools
description: devDependencies the M(n+1) refactorers in tools/ import. Copy these entries into the rebuild project's own package.json when the project reaches M(n+1); scripts/ stays zero-dependency and must never import from here. Pinned to the Babel 7 line the tools were built and re-run against (darkroom 7.25, raycastkbd 7.26, storytellingnoomo 7.29); one project ran them on 8.0.4 (basement) without incident, but that is one sample.
